dedupe_keys.name: ian bd pre and post disaster aerial imagery for building damage assessment from hurricane ian

description: Ian-BD is a set of 101 pre- and post-disaster aerial image pairs at 0.3 metres per pixel with building damage labels, after Hurricane Ian, a Category 4 hurricane that struck Florida in September 2022. It was published on DesignSafe in 2024 by Joseph Gyegyiri, Hongbo Su and Ajay Thapa. Pre-event images come from Lee County's aerial imagery database (early September 2022) and post-event images from NOAA's Hurricane Ian imagery of 29 and 30 September 2022. Building footprints were drawn on the pre-event images, transferred to the post-event images and assigned one of four classes: no damage, minor, major or destroyed; an independent team checked all annotations. It uses Florida building databases to reduce labelling cost and deals with buildings hidden by tree canopy. Coverage: about 80 per cent of Lee County, including all of Sanibel Island. Access: DesignSafe Data Depot. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: 101 image pairs, one event. Simulation uses: training and testing building damage models for rapid post-hurricane assessment. Related records: the Hurricane Harvey and Ian storm repair permits and the StEER reconnaissance reports.
